# Cncf Bank Vaults Reviewer

Review Bank-Vaults using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Bank-Vaults is a Vault swiss-army knife: a K8s operator, Go client with automatic token renewal, automatic configuration, multiple unseal options and more. A CLI tool to init, unseal and configure Vault (auth methods, secret engines). Direct secret injection into Pods.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
